    Removing an exact twist #

    A twisted multiplicative basis B of A over P gives a contour function c(p, q) = T(p)/T(q), where T(p) is the scalar with elt αₙ ⋯ elt α₁ = T(p) • elt (val p) along a path p = αₙ ⋯ α₁ (RayQuiver.MulBasis.contourFn). If it is exact, rescaling the basis gives a multiplicative basis, and A ≅ k(P) (RayQuiver.MulBasis.nonempty_algEquiv; Gabriel–Roiter 13.9).
